text:
maria: Quick design check — I updated the invite drawer to include a compact permissions summary badge next to each email entry. It shows short role + a hover inline help. Screenshot & spec: https://figma.com/file/abc123

josh: Nice, saw it. Is the hover accessible on keyboard? how does it appear for screen readers?

lena: Good Q. I sketched keyboard flow — tab to badge, press Enter to open the tooltip, Esc to close. Tooltip is ARIA role=dialog with aria-label "permission details".

omar: Sounds OK but I'm worried about focus trapping in the drawer modal. If tooltip is a dialog that steals focus you can break the invite form flow. Maybe use a tooltip (role=tooltip) instead of dialog?

maria: I considered tooltip but need interactive links in the help (learn more + link to roles matrix). Role=tooltip is non-interactive per a11y. Could we keep it as a small popover but ensure focus returns to the badge?

josh: Proposal: keep popover with role=dialog but don’t trap focus — manage focus programmatically: on open move focus into the popover, but on Esc or click outside, return focus to the originating badge. Add visible focus ring.

lena: Also we should add alt text for the compact badge icon and ensure 2:1 contrast for the badge background when selected. Current mock uses 2.5:1 which is low for small text.

maria: Good catch. I'll bump contrast and increase target tap area to 44px.

omar: Copy nit: hover help currently says "Can edit, view audit logs, and manage billing" — misleading for custom roles. Suggest: "This invite will grant the selected role. Role capabilities: Edit content, View audit logs, Manage billing (may vary for custom roles)." Shorter: "Role capabilities shown; custom role permissions may differ."

josh: +1 for clearer copy. Also add a tiny chevron action to collapse the details for long role descriptions so the badge doesn't grow the drawer height.

maria: UX ask: when multiple invites are selected and they have different roles, should badges show "Mixed roles" summary? I mocked "Mixed (3 roles)" which expands to per-email breakdown.

lena: Yeah show Mixed summary — but make it actionable: clicking reveals per-recipient badges. Keyboard and SR should announce the expansion: ""expanded list of invite recipients and roles""

omar: Another edge: SSO enforced orgs. If SSO is on and role assignment requires specific group mapping, the help should mention "Role mapping may be controlled by SSO group rules" and link to org settings.

design-bot: Reminder: run the invite drawer accessibility checklist after changes: keyboard nav, screen reader labels, contrast, target sizes, tooltip semantics.

maria: Thanks — I'll update Figma with the keyboard flow, new copy, and contrast changes. I'll also open a small PR with style tweaks and a11y attributes. Landing ETA: EOD tomorrow.

josh: Re: analytics - can we emit events when the badge is opened (permission_help_open) + when users click the learn-more link? Product wants to measure confusion rate.

omar: Add event for mixed-summary-expand too.

maria: Noted — I'll add telemetry props: source=invite_drawer, badge_type=compact, role_summary=expanded|collapsed.

lena: Quick QA note — audit log nav link in the popover should open in a new tab to keep the invite flow intact.

maria: Cool. I'll incorporate and ping for a quick review once PR is up. :rocket:

josh: LGTM — assign to me for frontend review.

omar: I'll do a security pass for SSO messaging before merge.
\lmaria: (typo)
